title: AI now shops and pays for shoppers; our store must be agent-ready
summary: Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI (NRF); ChatGPT Wallet buys from merchants; Klarna joined Adyen's agentic suite; Target's AI assistant lifted sales. European notebook revenue +16% (DigiTimes); PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028.

points.headline: AI shoppers and agent checkout are arriving together
points.detail: NRF finds half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI, ChatGPT Wallet lets agents buy from merchants, and Klarna joined Adyen's agentic suite. We should make our catalog and checkout agent-ready.

points.headline: Retailers' AI assistants are showing early sales lift
points.detail: Target reports an early sales lift from its Ask Target assistant in beta. We should test comparable guided shopping for PC buyers on our store.

points.headline: Memory and component costs lift PC prices while units stay weak
points.detail: European notebook revenue rose 16% on higher prices with fewer units, notebooks stay weak into Q2 2027 and a PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028. We should plan inventory and pricing for tight supply.

points.headline: Walmart's delivery speed is winning share in a key electronics channel
points.detail: Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% in Q3 as fulfillment speed set it apart. Our marketplace delivery promises need to match.
